title: Provision Docker capability for evidence ladder V2+ (sandbox has no docker)
description: V0 pre-flight discovered the Modal VM sandbox has no docker CLI, daemon, socket, podman, or nerdctl, and no DOCKER_HOST. Ladder steps V2 (live integration), V3 (qualification), V5 (upgrade lane), V6 (TLS lane), V7 (surrealkv lane) all require a Docker server for compose lanes. Options: sandbox image with docker, remote DOCKER_HOST to a docker-capable machine, or run V2+ from another environment against this branch.

title: Transcript capture pipeline: OpenCode plugin streaming turns/tool-calls/responses into bd audit + provenance
description: tools/opencode/beads-audit.ts registered in global opencode config. Captures user_turn (session prompt hook), tool_call (tool execute hooks), llm_call (event stream, assistant completions) into .beads/interactions.jsonl via 'bd audit record --stdin'; binds sessions to claimed beads with idempotent 'bd provenance record --ref-kind transcript'. Durability: events-journal on (90d/1M rows), events-export on, export.git-add on, bd git hooks installed, Dolt auto-backup (15m) + refs/dolt/data remote, JSONL files committed to main. Persistent storage: everything under /work (virtiofs mount).
close_reason: Implemented: plugin written, registered, config/hooks/backup verified
